result_text:
`analyzeLandscape` now works as the same command as `updateLandscape`. The `cli` module compiles. I didn't run any tests or the command itself, so none of the behaviour below has been exercised.

- **`CommandLineInterface.java`:** dispatch sends both names to the same landscape method, so every option works under either name. `-help` prints the usage for whichever name was typed.
- **`Commands.java`:** I added `ANALYZE_LANDSCAPE` and its description. The description says it is the landscape counterpart of the analysis commands and the same as `updateLandscape`. The no-argument overview now lists `analyzeLandscape` just before `updateLandscape`, and both use the same options.
- **`README.md`:** the README had no command descriptions, so I added a short "Landscape command" section. It documents `analyzeLandscape -analysisRoot <folder>` and the files it creates. It also notes that `updateLandscape` still works.
